resources.string: Block short-video feeds before they hook you.
Lets WuZhu detect Shorts, Reels, and other short-video elements on screen and cover them so they can\'t be watched.
WuZhu needs Accessibility access to see what\'s on screen and cover short-video elements. No data ever leaves your device.

WuZhu runs entirely on your device. Its Accessibility service watches the screen contents of whatever app is open, finds any actively playing video that matches its short-form feed detection rules, and fades in a cover over it over 10 seconds — enough time to see what it is, not enough to fall into it. Swiping to the next video reveals it again, restarting the countdown. Nothing is recorded, stored, or sent anywhere.
